name: Tiki Joe's at Captree Boat Basin
address: 3500 Ocean Pkwy (Captree Boat Basin, Captree State Park)

evidence.note: Official page: concession and Captain's Table restaurant at the boat basin, with a music schedule link.
Review mentions a band setting up on a Sunday afternoon; no mention of dancing.

dancing.notes: Bands play here on weekend afternoons by the boat basin, but we found no reports about dancing. It is mostly a casual place to eat and drink by the water.

description: A waterfront seafood restaurant and snack concession at the Captree State Park boat basin, with indoor and outdoor seating, bay views and weekend bands.
reviewNotes: Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Tiki Joe's has more than one location (for example at Cedar Beach); Ira specified Captree. Postal city/ZIP varies by listing (Babylon 11702, Bay Shore 11706, or 11757), so ZIP is left out. It is inside Captree State Park, where a state parking fee may apply. Mach 5 on Oct 4 not checked on the music schedule page. Ira's List has a /tiki-joes-venues page.
